title: SSRI DeepSlide Landslide Integration Gate — Release Readiness

checklist.evidence: STAC stack has real CRS and 14 bands, but value domain does not match Landslide4Sense competition tensors used to train DeepSlide; competition scaling is unpublished. Not a defensible model-compatible input.

Even if numeric gates pass, scientific_acceptance remains UNRESOLVED unless an independent spatially blocked inventory study is completed. This milestone does not claim scientific validation.

CRS written=EPSG:32653; empty_prediction=True; domain_matched=False; GeoTIFF carries real CRS and matches input affine, but predictions are domain-shifted uncalibrated scores, not validated landslide risk.
SSRI assess uses 13-channel Stage 2.5 stack; DeepSlide needs 14-band L4S. No new ingest pipeline implemented.

threshold_policy.selection: Fixed at DeepSlide documented default (sigmoid > 0.5). Not tuned on the evaluation set.
threshold_policy.scientific_note: Raw sigmoid outputs are uncalibrated segmentation scores, not risk probabilities.

held_out_eval.dataset: Landslide4Sense validation split (HF mirror with masks)
held_out_eval.rationale: DeepSlide trained on Landslide4Sense; public train chips are leakage-prone. Validation split is the competition held-out set with labels on HF mirrors.

absolute_micro_f1_floor.rationale: Floor below official IARAI U-Net validation F1 0.5782 to allow smaller subsample variance; not a claim of matching the leaderboard.

scientific_acceptance.policy: Even if numeric gates pass, scientific_acceptance remains UNRESOLVED unless an independent spatially blocked inventory study is completed. This milestone does not claim scientific validation.

rules: Input stack must include 14 bands in L4S order with documented provenance
Output GeoTIFF must carry a real CRS (not None) and affine matching the input window
Do not invent CRS for L4S HDF5 chips
Do not map SSRI 13-channel stack into 14 bands

required_checks: compare against unknown Render RAM with conservative 512MB-class caution
deployment.pass_rule: Single-chip CPU inference completes; peak RSS for model+one chip < 1500 MB; no claim of verified production deploy without live Render test

remediation_plan.action: Reproduce Landslide4Sense competition band scaling (or retrain/fine-tune DeepSlide on physically unit STAC stacks with spatial-block holdout).
remediation_plan.why: STAC georeferenced stacks are CRS-valid but domain-shifted; georef inference produced empty masks (max sigmoid≈0.01).

remediation_plan.action: Build SSRI 14-band ingest (S2 B1–B12 + DEM/slope) with CRS, replacing reliance on the 13-channel Stage 2.5 stack for landslide-only path.
remediation_plan.why: Assess/worker cannot feed DeepSlide without a new feature pipeline.

remediation_plan.action: Obtain ALOS PALSAR DEM/slope (or justify Copernicus DEM) and a real B10 source if required; keep B10 fill documented.
remediation_plan.why: L4S used ALOS PALSAR; STAC path used Copernicus GLO-30 and zero-filled B10.

remediation_plan.action: After domain-matched georef works, run labelled georeferenced AOI evaluation and a live Render memory/cold-start test with authorization.
remediation_plan.why: Phase 4 map usefulness and Phase 5 production verification remain open.

remediation_plan.action: Do not integrate behind /api/v1/assess until all PASS FOR INTEGRATION gates clear.
remediation_plan.why: Integration gate explicitly forbids partial pass.

limitations: L4S competition chips have no CRS; cannot georeference them honestly
Competition value scaling unpublished; STAC physical units ≠ training domain
Held-out numeric pass on HF validation labels; scientific validation UNRESOLVED
Sigmoid scores are uncalibrated — not risk probabilities
Production Render live test not authorized/executed
SSRI 13-channel assess path incompatible without new ingest
